title: Map exact narrowband radio capabilities
description:
Map narrow ordinary-LoRa bandwidth support for the exact chip, modem firmware, board and resolved driver revisions in rf.01. Compare primary command tables with actual API mappings and RF-path limitations. Keep ordinary LoRa separate from LR-FHSS and hypothetical 250/500 Hz CSS.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Read-only research using rf.01/rf.02 evidence. No hardware probing, profile activation, code import or external contact. Unsupported settings remain unsupported until separately approved implementation and qualification work exists.
acceptance_criteria: Source-backed entries distinguish silicon RX/TX capability, driver-exposed settings and unverified board support. Verify current enum support instead of assuming all silicon modes are available or that SX1262 and LR1110 match. Record actual manifest/toolchain mismatches rather than silently choosing a version.
